cabinCategories.description: Elegant interior stateroom with Holland America's signature Mariner's Dream bed, premium linens, and thoughtful Dutch design.
Classic ocean-view stateroom with large window — ideal for scenic Inside Passage days when Alaska glides past.

inclusions: All meals in main dining and Lido Market

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Holland America's classic Noordam departs on a 7-night Glacier Bay Alaska voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Explore Alaska's scenic capital — Mendenhall Glacier, Mount Roberts Tramway, and the lively waterfront all await. World-class whale watching just minutes from the dock.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: Scenic cruising through Glacier Bay — one of the world's last great wilderness areas. Watch tidewater glaciers calve into the sea while National Park Rangers provide expert narration.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: The jewel of Southeast Alaska. St. Michael's Cathedral, the Sitka National Historical Park, and remarkable sea otter colonies make Sitka unforgettable.
portsOfCall.name: Sitka, AK

portsOfCall.description: Creek Street, totem pole parks, and outstanding fresh seafood highlight this beloved Alaska port of call.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: Cruise the protected waters of the Inside Passage — keep watch for humpback whales, orcas, Dall's porpoise, and bald eagles.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

reviewSnippet: A mid-size Holland America ship with a calm pace, attentive service, and Glacier Bay on the itinerary — a comfortable pick for travelers who prioritize scenery over onboard thrills.
